source.inspectionScope: Fresh full71-line three-manifest patch read. Historical and fixed AddrBookManager auto-enumeration guard skips OS address books under automation/XPCSHELL_TEST_PROFILE_DIR, making old disabling prefs unnecessary in that path. Exact two surviving manifest heads and one later split composition head read; original composition/browser.toml absent at fixed revision. No claim explicit manual OS address-book creation is disabled, and no harness or native provider test ran.

commit d227bb477ed9ce22ec5636602ec9c64cfd4778d2
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Apr 16 16:38:41 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Wed Apr 16 16:38:41 2025 +1200

    Bug 1901705 - Remove redundant prefs in test manifests. rs=me
    These preferences aren't necessary any more. The OS address books won't start under test conditions.

diff --git a/mail/components/addrbook/test/browser/browser.toml b/mail/components/addrbook/test/browser/browser.toml
index 315af12ff31..f587ceab711 100644
--- a/mail/components/addrbook/test/browser/browser.toml
+++ b/mail/components/addrbook/test/browser/browser.toml
@@ -3,7 +3,6 @@ head = "head.js"
 prefs = [
   "carddav.setup.loglevel=Debug",
   "carddav.sync.loglevel=Debug",
-  "ldap_2.servers.osx.dirType=-1",
   "mail.provider.suppress_dialog_on_startup=true",
   "mail.spotlight.firstRunDone=true",
   "mail.winsearch.firstRunDone=true",
diff --git a/mail/components/im/test/browser/browser.toml b/mail/components/im/test/browser/browser.toml
index 18ae3d2cb26..d71d68ca1ec 100644
--- a/mail/components/im/test/browser/browser.toml
+++ b/mail/components/im/test/browser/browser.toml
@@ -1,14 +1,11 @@
 [default]
 prefs = [
-  "ldap_2.servers.osx.description=",
-  "ldap_2.servers.osx.dirType=-1",
-  "ldap_2.servers.osx.uri=",
+  "chat.otr.enable=false",
   "mail.provider.suppress_dialog_on_startup=true",
   "mail.spotlight.firstRunDone=true",
   "mail.winsearch.firstRunDone=true",
   "mailnews.start_page.override_url=about:blank",
   "mailnews.start_page.url=about:blank",
-  "chat.otr.enable=false",
 ]
 subsuite = "thunderbird"
 head = "head.js"
diff --git a/mail/test/browser/composition/browser.toml b/mail/test/browser/composition/browser.toml
index b5ff037b088..81b02a326b1 100644
--- a/mail/test/browser/composition/browser.toml
+++ b/mail/test/browser/composition/browser.toml
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 [default]
 head = "head.js"
 prefs = [
-  "ldap_2.servers.osx.dirType=-3",
+  "datareporting.policy.dataSubmissionPolicyBypassNotification=true",
   "mail.account.account1.server=server1",
   "mail.account.account2.identities=id1,id2",
   "mail.account.account2.server=server2",
@@ -34,15 +34,14 @@ prefs = [
   "mail.server.server2.whiteListAbURI=",
   "mail.shell.checkDefaultClient=false",
   "mail.smtp.defaultserver=smtp1",
-  "mail.smtpserver.smtp1.type=smtp",
   "mail.smtpserver.smtp1.hostname=tinderbox123",
+  "mail.smtpserver.smtp1.type=smtp",
   "mail.smtpserver.smtp1.username=tinderbox",
   "mail.smtpservers=smtp1",
   "mail.spotlight.firstRunDone=true",
   "mail.winsearch.firstRunDone=true",
   "mailnews.start_page.override_url=about:blank",
   "mailnews.start_page.url=about:blank",
-  "datareporting.policy.dataSubmissionPolicyBypassNotification=true",
 ]
 skip-if = ["os == 'linux' && bits == 32 && debug"]  # Perma-fail
 subsuite = "thunderbird"
